title: Davy Jones, Joe Robichaux and Sam White
summary: Short answers on who he played with: Joe Robichaux on road trips with Sam Morgan, and a few jobs with Sam White.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well that's right, Small. Yeah. What about Davy Jones? Did you ever know him?
Oh yeah, but I never played, I never played with him. He's a good musician. I never played with him.
What about Joe Robichaux in the old days before you got, you know, you make you come back with Bunk?

Who the old man? Young Joe. Young Joe. Oh. No, I never played with, yeah, I played with Joe, yeah, Joe played with me a couple of times with Sam Bang. We went on the road, Birmingham, different places, Mobile. Yeah, Joe played a couple of jobs with us.
So he worked with Sam Joe then?
Yeah, Joe worked many jobs there with Sam.
You worked much with Sam White? Who? Sam White, you know, the drummer. Edmund Washington?
No, no. Oh yeah, I worked a couple of jobs with him, but not too many, you see. Sam White.
